items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: I was playing with the Camellia band. And you must have stayed with them for a while. I did stay with Johnny.

ctx.x: Oh, who were you playing with when the September storm hit here? In September?

We were Johnny Predoss. That's in 1950. Yeah, the Camellia band. I was playing with the Camellia band. And you must have stayed with them for a while. I did stay with Johnny. I stayed with Johnny. Those used to work from one place to the other, from one band to the other. Fellas would hire me when Johnny didn't have nothing. They'd come in hire me. That's just like the fellas do now, you know? What about when the Depression hit?
Who were you with? In the Depression? Yeah.
